description: Find entities by keyword query (FTS5 search), type, region, spatial proximity, tags, or status. Alternatively, provide entity_id for single-entity location and historical trajectory lookup.

entity_id.description: Specific entity ID to look up directly (returns location and state)

history_limit.description: Maximum number of history events to return when include_history is true (default: 20)

include_history.description: If true and entity_id is specified, returns recent movement/event history

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return (default: 50)

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence score (e.g. 0.5 to filter out decayed entities)

near_position.description: Center position for proximity distance search

query.description: Full-text search query across entity names, tags, and properties

name: query_entities
